interpretation.plain_speak: Rotating which name comes first, middle, or last does not remove the balanced-training cost under per-name evaluation. The cost follows the name-local grouping pattern itself. At the same time, balancing still helps the weakest family, so the fairness benefit is real even though mean older-family accuracy pays a small locality cost.
interpretation.north_star_question: Identifies per-name locality rather than name-boundary position as the interaction limiting recency equalization, narrowing the language mechanism that must be resolved before general scheduling.
interpretation.next_stage: hold balanced-prior training fixed and break apart per-name locality by selectively interleaving one clause type across names while preserving identical content and update/query structure
